audited_native_source_definition: Collapse registered edit variants; exclude classroom and evaluation_routing duplicate audit cohort. Retain distinct registered base IDs even when theme names coincide.
differential_disagreement_unit: Probe configurations in ONE authored room; six finding categories (four initial plus two extended), four backend-bug categories and two specification-ambiguity categories. Not 720 distinct bugs or independent rooms.

delta_reject_cluster_statistics.effective_resampling_unit: source room; all calls and arms in each selected room retained together
delta_reject_cluster_statistics.estimands: call-weighted rates (primary) and equal-room rates (sensitivity); paired arm differences

delta_detector_statistics.cluster_caveat: Classroom has one source room: bootstrap intervals are degenerate and provide no between-room population uncertainty. Generated has six rooms only. Wilson treats models as Bernoulli trials and is descriptive, not dependence-adjusted.
delta_detector_statistics.cluster_unit: metadata.room; six generated source rooms, one classroom source room; never treat mutants or probes as independent rooms
delta_detector_statistics.detector_truth_definition: Retained routing_faulty label from agreeing I1/I2. Positive means declared routing fault, not generic invalidity. Gate0/I1/I2 are oracle sanity checks only.
delta_detector_statistics.loader_definition: Vc_instance OR Vc_trace rejection; backend setup refusal is recorded rejection, not missing execution
delta_detector_statistics.union_definition: OR of Va_structural, Vb_native_domain, backend_setup, and Vc_instance/Vc_trace; unavailable unrelated metrics do not remove negatives

delta_exploratory_ablation_decomposition.reused_implementation: experiments/report_mutation_analysis.py:key,admitted; analyze() priority copied unchanged for legacy_* admission-only columns
delta_exploratory_ablation_decomposition.fully_agreed_definition: Exact equality of decision,reason,provider,action; includes admitted and rejected outcomes, separately exposed
delta_exploratory_ablation_decomposition.decision_provider_definition: After oracle-rejection admissions removed, any decision/provider mismatch; includes rejected outcomes, unlike original admission-only scope
delta_exploratory_ablation_decomposition.reason_only_definition: Same decision,provider,action but different reason; separate from fully agreed; admitted/rejected subtotals explicit
delta_exploratory_ablation_decomposition.warning: reach_only aggregate includes intentionally unbound action and MUST NOT be quoted as unsafe admissions. Oracle-rejected admissions count actual admission of an oracle-rejected request; no model-quality/deployment claim.

delta_legacy_ablation_aggregate_definiti: Legacy wrongly-admitted aggregate includes intentionally unbound action mismatches; NEVER quote reach_only aggregate as unsafe admissions. Use exploratory oracle_rejection_admitted instead.

delta_property_scope.unit_warning: 7000 configuration observations, 4750 distinct model hashes, not 7000 independent models.
delta_property_scope.assertion_evidence: Direct retained fields where present, otherwise terminal pass plus hash-pinned harness control flow. No re-execution.
delta_property_scope.setup_refusal_semantics: Campaign-level pre-request setup refusals; repeated in assertion rows for visibility, never summed.
delta_property_scope.model_calls: Scripted stub calls in historical tests, not API calls.
